observations.body: Pharaoh’s recognition of God-given wisdom leads to authority, public procession, fine linen, a chain, an Egyptian name, and marriage to Asenath.
observations.label: Pharaoh gives Joseph office, ring, robes, and a new name

observations.body: The passage presents Pharaoh appoints Joseph over Egypt and gives him Asenath as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Pharaoh appoints Joseph over Egypt and gives him Asenath

observations.body: The passage places Pharaoh attributes Joseph’s discernment to God beside Pharaoh appoints Joseph over Egypt and gives him Asenath.
observations.label: Pharaoh attributes Joseph’s discernment to God

payload.posture: Read Genesis 41:37–45 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
